mapper.update: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE name = 'SIMULATIONS' and xtype = 'U') CREATE TABLE SIMULATIONS ( id int IDENTITY (1,1) NOT NULL, device_id int NOT NULL, target text COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL, strPolicy text COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL, [interval] int NOT NULL, enabled int NOT NULL CONSTRAINT SIMULATIONS_PK PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT FK_SIMULATIONS_DEVICES FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES DEVICES (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE );
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SIMULATIONS(device_id, target, strPolicy, interval, enabled) VALUES (#{device_id}, #{target}, #{strPolicy}, #{interval}, #{enabled});
